house:119:2:286.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Concur in the Senate Amendments
house:119:2:286.reason: Exact House choice is suspension and concurrence in the Senate amendments to H.R.6500, not a vote only on the original AGOA title. Whole64,001-character EAS read and full own floor reproduction matches under declared formatting comparison. It replaces everything after the enacting clause with Continuing Appropriations and Extensions Act2027, changes the title, and contains four divisions; division references stay division-specific unless expressly provided. DivisionA continues twelve specified FY2026 appropriations sources at qualified rates/authority/conditions with named exceptions, no-new-project and limited-funding rules and the section106 earliest-of termination alternatives, one of which is December11,2026. DivisionB includes AGOA/customs extensions, joint-task-force sunset substitution in2013 and Western-Hemisphere passport-fee authority substitution in2017; these precise imports may bear on Immigration but do not establish the whole adopted package meaning or stance without the material source chain. Homeland-Security funding imports and relevant appropriations/authorization/current-integration application remain research. DivisionsC/D surface-transportation and VA extensions retained as whole-choice context, no isolated component stance or automatic Immigration exclusion/inclusion. Keep researched source_unresolved noncounting hold; no funding outcome, individual passport/benefit determination, enactment, new shared meaning or editorial acceptance.
